notes: Unknown image file extensions are allowed when the downloaded content is detected as an image.
Files are not required to use a known extension; extensionless files, custom config files, source files, and plaintext-like files are accepted when their bytes look like text.
Video input is URL-only, supports files up to 80 MB, and must use the active platform's trusted HTTPS video hosts; inline Base64/data video is rejected.
The API forwards remote URLs without downloading or probing them.
Known audio, archive, executable, installer, shared library, and unsupported Office/binary document formats remain blocked.
This Core-backed model may use extended thinking time; use client-side request timeouts suitable for long-running text inference.
